mapper.select: SELECT context_snapshot FROM dsh_worker_states WHERE AND context_snapshot IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE dsh_worker_states SET context_snapshot = #{snapshot,sensitive=true} WHERE AND context_snapshot IS NULL

UPDATE code_sessions SET worker_lease_expires_at = #{expiresAt}, worker_registered_at = NOW(), worker_token_session_id = external_id, worker_status = COALESCE(worker_status, 'idle'), worker_binding = '{"auth_mode":"session_ingress_token"}', worker_last_heartbeat_at = NULL, connection_status = 'connected', last_worker_connected_at = NOW(), last_worker_activity_at = NOW(), worker_claim_requested_at = NULL, worker_claim_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE organization_uuid = #{scope.OrganizationUUID} AND workspace_uuid = #{scope.WorkspaceUUID} AND uuid = #{scope.CodeSessionUUID} AND current_worker_epoch = #{scope.Epoch} AND status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dsh_worker_states (organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, code_session_uuid) VALUES (#{scope.OrganizationUUID}, #{scope.WorkspaceUUID}, #{scope.CodeSessionUUID}) ON CONFLICT (organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, code_session_uuid) DO NOTHING
